segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO
segments.en: Micron delivered record revenue in fiscal Q3, driven by exceptional DRAM pricing. DRAM ASPs increased in the mid-60s percent range sequentially, an unprecedented move in our history.
segments.zh: 美光第三财季营收创纪录，主要由异常强劲的 DRAM 价格驱动。DRAM 平均售价环比上涨约 60% 多（mid-60s%），为公司历史上前所未有的涨幅。

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO
segments.en: HBM revenue exceeded $1 billion in the quarter for the first time. Our HBM output is sold out through calendar 2027, and we have locked in pricing for a portion of 2027 and 2028 volumes under long-term agreements.
segments.zh: HBM 收入单季首次超过 10 亿美元。我们的 HBM 产出已售罄至 2027 日历年，并已通过长期协议锁定 2027 与 2028 年部分量的价格。

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO
segments.en: Data center demand continues to outpace supply. Lead times for standard DDR5 modules have extended beyond 26 weeks in some cases.
segments.zh: 数据中心需求持续超过供给。标准 DDR5 模组的交期在部分情况下已延长至 26 周以上。

segments.speaker: Mark Murphy — CFO
segments.en: We remain disciplined on capital spending. Fiscal 2026 capex will stay within our prior envelope, and we are not adding greenfield wafer capacity this year; incremental spend is directed to HBM assembly and test.
segments.zh: 我们在资本开支上保持克制。2026 财年 capex 将维持在此前区间内，今年不新增 greenfield 晶圆产能；增量开支投向 HBM 封装与测试。

segments.speaker: Mark Murphy — CFO
segments.en: Inventory days ended the quarter at 136, down from 150 a year ago.
segments.zh: 季末库存天数为 136 天，低于一年前的 150 天。

segments.speaker: Analyst — 提问
segments.en: Can you help us understand how much of calendar 2027 and 2028 supply is covered by LTAs, and whether pricing is fixed?
segments.zh: 能否帮我们理解 2027、2028 日历年有多少供给已被长期协议覆盖？价格是否锁定？

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO 回答
segments.en: A portion of 2027 and 2028 HBM volumes is locked with fixed pricing; we won't quantify the exact percentage. Standard DRAM remains largely spot and quarterly negotiated.
segments.zh: 2027 与 2028 年部分 HBM 量已按固定价格锁定；具体比例不做量化。标准 DRAM 仍以现货与季度议价为主。

segments.speaker: Analyst — 提问
segments.en: Given the pricing environment, why not accelerate capacity additions?
segments.zh: 在当前价格环境下，为什么不加速扩产？

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO 回答
segments.en: We are prioritizing profitability and supply discipline over share. Our capex stance is unchanged — disciplined.
segments.zh: 我们把盈利能力与供给纪律置于市场份额之上。capex 立场不变——保持克制。

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO 回答
segments.en: On double-ordering: we monitor pull-ins closely; our delivery commitments are aligned with customers' build plans.
segments.zh: 关于重复下单：我们密切关注客户提前拉货；我们的交付承诺与客户的建置计划保持一致。

four_questions.a: 洽谈中，2027 年量尚未签约

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO
segments.en: Fiscal Q2 marked a strong step-up in DRAM pricing, with ASPs up approximately 20% sequentially.
segments.zh: 第二财季 DRAM 价格显著抬升，平均售价环比上涨约 20%。

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO
segments.en: HBM revenue grew more than 50% sequentially, and our 2026 HBM output is effectively sold out. We are in active discussions with customers on 2027 agreements.
segments.zh: HBM 收入环比增长超过 50%，2026 年 HBM 产出基本售罄。我们正与客户积极洽谈 2027 年协议。

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO
segments.en: We believe we are in the early innings of a broad-based memory recovery.
segments.zh: 我们认为目前处于一轮广泛存储复苏的早期阶段。

segments.speaker: Mark Murphy — CFO
segments.en: We will remain flexible on capex and invest with discipline as visibility improves.
segments.zh: 我们将在 capex 上保持弹性，随可见度改善再有纪律地投资。

segments.speaker: Analyst — 提问
segments.en: Any update on long-term agreements for 2027?
segments.zh: 2027 年长期协议有何进展？

segments.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra — CEO 回答
segments.en: Discussions are ongoing; nothing signed for 2027 volumes at this point.
segments.zh: 洽谈仍在进行；目前 2027 年的量尚未签约。

HBM 占 DRAM 收入比重超过 40%

segments.speaker: Kim Woo-hyun — CFO
segments.en: First-quarter operating margin reached approximately 49%, the highest in the company's history, on surging HBM and server DRAM demand.
segments.zh: 第一季度营业利润率达到约 49%，为公司历史最高，受 HBM 与服务器 DRAM 需求激增带动。

segments.speaker: Kim Woo-hyun — CFO
segments.en: HBM revenue accounted for over 40% of total DRAM revenue in the quarter.
segments.zh: 本季 HBM 收入占 DRAM 总收入的比重超过 40%。

segments.speaker: Kim Woo-hyun — CFO
segments.en: Regarding capital expenditure, we will maintain a flexible stance: infrastructure investment continues, while equipment investment will be decided in line with market conditions.
segments.zh: 关于资本开支，我们将保持弹性立场：基础设施投资持续进行，设备投资将视市场状况决定。

segments.speaker: Kim Woo-hyun — CFO
segments.en: Some of the demand strength reflects customers' inventory build ahead of anticipated price increases, which warrants monitoring.

segments.speaker: Analyst — 提问
segments.en: How should we think about NAND supply discipline from here?
segments.zh: 接下来应如何看待 NAND 的供给纪律？

segments.speaker: Kim Woo-hyun — CFO 回答
segments.en: We will keep NAND utilization below full levels until profitability normalizes.
segments.zh: 在盈利恢复正常之前，我们将维持 NAND 稼动率低于满载水平。
